sources.title: Gemma 3n E4B IT launch model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Identifies this repository as the launch E4B instruction-tuned model for Transformers. Reports 8B raw parameters versus a 4B-comparable memory footprint and supports text, audio, image and video inputs.

sources.title: Introducing Gemma 3n: The developer guide
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Dated June 26, 2025; announces the full release after the May preview. Reports E4B total 8B, nested MatFormer, PLE, LAuReL, AltUp, shared KV cache, audio and MobileNet-v5 vision encoders. Elastic switching was not part of launch implementations.

sources.title: Gemma 3n model overview
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Defines effective parameters as reduced memory load obtained with PLE caching and conditional loading. Separates text, vision, audio and PLE groups. E4B contains an E2B submodel; audio/vision loading can be skipped. The linked parameter diagram describes E2B only.

sources.title: Gemma 3n model card
sources.evidence: Names Google DeepMind as author and Gemma as family, confirms open pretrained and instruction-tuned weights, text/image/video/audio input, text output and a shared 32K-token input-plus-output budget. Links Gemma Terms of Use.

sources.title: Gemma Terms of Use
sources.evidence: The current terms page retains Gemma Terms of Use for listed pre-Gemma-4 models; the Gemma 3n card directly links these terms.

sources.title: Public Hub metadata for Google Gemma 3n E4B IT
sources.evidence: Revision c1221e9c62e34a43ab7ffacd1be0ea71f126ef10 reports safetensors parameters BF16=7,849,978,192 and four weight shards. Public architecture metadata names Gemma3nForConditionalGeneration. This is an aggregate, not an independently inspected tensor inventory.

sources.title: Released Transformers Gemma 3n implementation
sources.evidence: Defines the text Transformer, audio tower, vision tower and modality embedders, tied lm_head and nonpersistent registered buffers. Shared-KV paths bypass later-layer K/V calculation; PLE and activation sparsity prevent interpreting accelerator memory size as a uniform active-parameter count.

sources.title: Released Transformers Gemma 3n configuration
sources.evidence: E4B-style configuration uses 35 text layers, hidden width 2048, FFN width 16384, maximum position embeddings 32768, 15 KV-sharing layers, and separate audio/vision configurations.

sources.title: Gemma 3n MatFormer Lab
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Official notebook identifies E4B as 35 layers with 16384 FFN width. Its displayed main-model row labels 3.98B as Effective Params, while the nested E2B is 1.91B. These are not complete checkpoint totals or defined per-token active counts.

sources.title: Announcing Gemma 3n preview: powerful, efficient, mobile-first AI
sources.evidence: May 20, 2025 announcement explicitly describes an early preview and staged modality availability; it does not identify the later launch Transformers checkpoint as an identical artifact.

sources.title: Gemma 3n E4B LiteRT preview model card
sources.evidence: Separate preview repository has a current-checkpoint restriction to text and vision. Its introductory E2B wording conflicts with the E4B repository title, so it is not used to transfer exact variant specifications to the June launch.

sources.title: On-device small language models with multimodality, RAG, and Function Calling
sources.evidence: May 20 article pairs Gemma 3n preview models with Google AI Edge function-calling libraries. It is positive family/preview evidence of prompted tool support, but does not explicitly identify the June E4B IT Transformers checkpoint.

sources.title: Official launch configuration download
sources.evidence: Returned HTTP 401. The official index and raw card downloads also returned 401; no gated files or weight shards were downloaded.

sources.title: Official launch Safetensors index
sources.evidence: Returned HTTP 401. Exact stored tensor names/shapes and shared-weight omission could not be independently checked.

sources.title: Pinned Gemma 3n E4B IT checkpoint metadata
sources.evidence: Fetched October 27, 2026. Revision c1221e9c62e34a43ab7ffacd1be0ea71f126ef10 still reports 7,849,978,192 BF16 safetensors elements. This corroborates Google’s nominal 8B complete-model specification; no weight files or new tensor census were used.

sources.title: KerasHub model preset parameter table
sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026. Exact gemma3n_e4b_it preset lists 7.85B parameters and describes the instruction-tuned multimodal model as approximately 8B total and 4B effective parameters. The companion base E4B entry has the same counts; neither labels 4B an active-per-token count.

sources.title: Gemma 4 technical report: Gemma 3n comparison
sources.evidence: Read the full fresh October 27 cached report, including architecture sections and Gemma 3n comparison tables. Section 2.2 identifies the Gemma 3n audio encoder as 680M parameters; Table 7 includes the E4B comparison. This is an audio-component specification, not a complete-model active count. The 3.8B activated count belongs to Gemma 4 26B-A4B; the newer E4B effective count likewise cannot be transferred to Gemma 3n.

sources.title: Apple Intelligence Foundation Language Models: Gemma 3n E4B comparison
sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026. Section 8 explicitly evaluates instruct/non-thinking variants and Table 1 names Gemma-3n-E4B, but supplies only benchmark scores. The adjacent comparison of active parameter sizes concerns AFM Server and Llama 4 Scout, not Gemma 3n. No nominal active-count convention is stated for the E4B row.

sources.title: Bitpute Gemma 3n E4B IT memory estimate (rejected active-count lead)
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-model active-parameter search found this page; read October 27, 2026. It claims 4.0B active per token while calling Gemma 3n a mixture-of-experts model and asserting every parameter must reside in memory. Those explanations conflict with Google’s MatFormer, PLE offload and conditional-loading documentation. The page provides no count-specific primary basis that establishes 4B as a nominal active count; it is not used as specification evidence.

name.note: Exact launch repository identifies E4B IT (instruction tuned); distinct from the base E4B and LiteRT preview repositories.

developer.note: Google publishes the weights; the card credits Google DeepMind.

family.note: Gemma 3n is a member of the Gemma family.

release_date.note: June 26 is the explicit full-release date, bridged to this repository by its launch-version statement. May 20 is the earlier limited preview in separate artifacts. No exact-checkpoint identity bridge warrants backdating this record to May.

open_weights.note: Official pretrained and instruction-tuned weights are distributed under an acceptance-gated open-weights license; the access gate does not make the model closed-weight.

license.note: Named terms are linked from the exact model card.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 re-audit confirms Google’s published nominal complete E4B total of 8B, including PLE and multimodal components. The exact E4B IT card, full-release guide, pinned Hub metadata and KerasHub preset agree: the latter lists 7.85B while describing it as approximately 8B total. Hub metadata reports 7,849,978,192 BF16 elements. Retain the developer’s rounded specification without requiring a new tensor census. The instruction-tuned and base E4B presets share that nominal size; the nested E2B and Mix-n-Match slices alter layers/FFN widths and do not establish a substitute complete E4B total.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-name and checkpoint-ID searches covered total, active/activated, effective and component counts, named-base relationships and later original comparison tables. No supported nominal whole-model active count was found. Google defines E4B (~4B; MatFormer Lab 3.98B) as effective accelerator-memory loading after PLE offload and optional modality loading; Keras preserves that distinction. Nested model selection, conditional encoders, shared KV paths and activation sparsity do not themselves publish an active-weight count. Apple’s exact E4B comparison gives benchmark scores only. The later Gemma 4 report discloses a 680M Gemma 3n audio component, not a complete active count. Bitpute’s 4B active claim lacks primary support and misidentifies this architecture as MoE. Retain null because the nominal active specification remains unsupported, not because an exact census is missing.

architecture.note: MatFormer Transformer text backbone with nested submodels, PLE, AltUp, LAuReL and local/global attention with shared KV cache; separate audio and MobileNet-v5 vision encoders. The released implementation uses one gated feed-forward network per layer, not routed MoE experts. The broad transformer classification preserves the conditional and activation-sparse execution details without implying every stored weight participates in every token.

context_window.note: Google specifies 32K combined input/output tokens; the released E4B-style configuration resolves this as max_position_embeddings=32768. LiteRT deployment-specific 4096 limits are not the launch model limit.

modalities.note: The exact launch card includes image and video vision inputs, audio and text; output is text. Add the omitted video modality.

reasoning.note: The sources report reasoning evaluations and permit chain-of-thought prompting, but do not establish a dedicated thinking/reasoning mode or a definitive model-wide negative for this exact variant. Clear the unsupported false flag.

tool_call.note: Google positively reports prompted function calling for the May Gemma 3n preview via AI Edge. No source inspected explicitly bridges that capability to this exact June launch checkpoint; the current generic function-calling URL redirects to Gemma 4. The native chat template lacking a tools argument does not establish lack of prompted support. Clear the unsupported false flag rather than asserting absence.

description.value: Google’s instruction-tuned Gemma 3n E4B model accepts text, images, audio and video and generates text. It uses a nested MatFormer architecture designed for devices with limited memory.
description.note: Plain summary of the exact launch model and its documented inputs/output and architecture.

patch.description: Google’s instruction-tuned Gemma 3n E4B model accepts text, images, audio and video and generates text. It uses a nested MatFormer architecture designed for devices with limited memory.

sources.label: Google AI Edge preview tool-calling announcement

patch.notes: 8B is Google’s nominal complete E4B count. E4B and 3.98B describe effective memory loading; a separate active-parameter count is not disclosed. June 26 dates this complete launch checkpoint; May offered a limited preview. Dedicated reasoning-mode and exact-checkpoint tool support remain unverified.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains Google’s nominal 8B complete total and explicitly patches active parameters to null. Fresh original documentation, pinned checkpoint metadata and KerasHub distinguish total parameters from effective memory loading; later Apple and Gemma research comparisons do not establish an E4B active count. Rejected an unsupported secondary 4B active claim. No exact census is required to accept the nominal total. Prior non-parameter assessments remain unchanged, including June 26 launch identity, open weights, license, 32768 context, video input and unresolved dedicated reasoning/tool support.
